title: Hahn splits the atom in 1938

tellings.quote: That was um uh happened to be a Nazi scientist by the name of um Han I think uh who did an experiment in 1938 and uh was first uh to split the atom.

plain: In 1938, a scientist named Otto Hahn, whom Robert Salas calls 'a Nazi scientist', became the first to split the atom in an experiment in Germany. Salas, a former Air Force officer who tells Michels of a UFO shutting down nuclear missiles, gives this from memory, saying the name is 'Han I think', as the starting point of the nuclear age.
